title: Magnetic field direction
description: Essential: Student must state that the magnetic field points along the negative z-axis (into the page/screen).

title: Stabilization voltage U₀
description: Essential: Final answer for part (2) must be U₀ = ρ₀ρgl/(2B).

title: Condition for continuous rise
description: Essential: Final answer for part (3) must be U ≥ ρ₀ρgl/B.

title: Force balance reasoning
description: Important: Student must equate the upward Ampere/Lorentz force (BIl) to the weight of the raised liquid column.

title: Resistance calculation
description: Important: Student must correctly express the liquid resistance as R = ρl/(2hb) when height doubles.

title: General height relationship
description: Important: Student must derive or apply U = [(n-1)/n]·(ρρ₀gl/B) for height factor n.

title: Limit analysis
description: Optional: Student may take the limit as n→∞ to obtain the threshold voltage from the general expression.

title: Sign/direction error
description: Pitfall: Incorrect magnetic field direction (e.g., positive z) or wrong force direction.

title: Resistance misuse
description: Pitfall: Using incorrect geometry for resistance (e.g., R = ρl/hb instead of ρl/(2hb) for doubled height).
